# Cloak

> Cloak is a free, open source PDF redaction tool that runs entirely in the browser. It uses an on-device AI model and pattern matching to find personally identifiable information (PII) in PDF documents, lets the user review it, and removes it permanently. No file is ever uploaded to a server. All processing happens locally on the user's device.

## What it does

Cloak lets users drop a PDF, detects PII with a PII detection model running in the browser on the CPU (WebAssembly) plus pattern matching, and produces a redacted PDF. Redacted text is removed from the file, not just covered with a black box. The redacted file can be downloaded immediately.

PII types detected include: names, locations, email addresses, phone numbers, US Social Security numbers and dates of birth. The model can also flag addresses, ID numbers and other identifiers. Cloak is built for English-language documents.

## How it works

1. User drops or selects a PDF on the landing page
2. MuPDF (running as WebAssembly in the browser) extracts the text page by page
3. A PII detection model (run with Transformers.js) and pattern matching find personal information on each page
4. The user reviews every detection, can add their own text, and can choose images and links to remove
5. MuPDF applies true redactions and removes metadata, comments, attachments and form data
6. The redacted PDF is available for download

Optional: users who run Ollama on their own computer can use a local LLM for detection and give plain-English redaction instructions.

All processing is client-side. No network requests are made with document content. The only downloads are the site itself and the detection model, which is cached in the browser after the first run.

## Key facts

- URL: https://cloakdoc.app
- Free to use, no account required
- Open source under AGPL-3.0: https://github.com/pulkit-jasti/cloak-document-redactor
- Works without an internet connection once the page and model have loaded
- Supports text-based PDFs (scanned, image-only pages are not read yet)
- Desktop browsers only (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari)
- Built with React, Vite, MuPDF and Transformers.js
- Detection runs on the CPU through WebAssembly

## Pages

- [Home / Upload](https://cloakdoc.app/): Drop a PDF to begin redaction
